gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients in Cohort D will have primary CNS tumours (such as, but not limited to, meningioma, glioblastoma, astrocytoma, ependymoma, and other rare histologies).

candidate_evidence.quote: One-time CSF collective via lumbar puncture or Ommaya reservoir and collection of concurrent plasma of peripheral blood (liquid biopsy).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient is eligible at any time point in their treatment course

coder_notes: Liquid-biopsy feasibility study (CSF/plasma ctDNA) across solid tumours; glioblastoma is named only as an example within Cohort D (primary CNS tumours) in the inclusion criteria. No drug intervention. ctDNA/CSF biomarkers are generic detection endpoints, not specific molecular biomarkers, so none recorded.
